title: CISA Catalog of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j2 JNDI Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Log4j2 versions 2.0-beta9 through 2.15.0 JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Progress MOVEit Transfer SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Progress MOVEit Transfer contains an SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain access to the MOVEit Transfer database.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Sensitive Information Disclosure Vulnerability (CitrixBleed)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows sensitive information disclosure without authentication.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SonicOS Improper Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SonicWall SonicOS contains an improper access control vulnerability in the management interface and SSLVPN allowing remote authentication bypass.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: An authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel in FortiOS, FortiProxy and FortiSwitchManager allows unauthenticated user to perform operations via specially crafted HTTP requests.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Barracuda Email Security Gateway contains a command injection vulnerability in the processing of .tar files, resulting in arbitrary system command execution.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product.
